definitions.explanation: Material wealth, money, or valuable possessions. Can also refer to abundance or richness in a broader sense.

examples.japanese: {富|とみ}と{名声|めいせい}を{手|て}に{入|い}れる。
{富|とみ}の{分配|ぶんぱい}が{不公平|ふこうへい}だと{批判|ひはん}されている。
examples.english: The distribution of wealth is being criticized as unfair.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}は{何|なに}よりも{大|おお}きな{富|とみ}だと、{年|とし}を{取|と}ってから{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: I realized as I got older that health is the greatest wealth of all.

notes:
{富|とみ} is a noun meaning wealth or riches. It can refer to both material wealth and abstract richness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {富|とみ}を{築|きず}く (to build wealth)
- {富|とみ}を{得|え}る (to gain wealth)
- {富|とみ}の{分配|ぶんぱい} (distribution of wealth)
- {富|とみ}と{権力|けんりょく} (wealth and power)
- {富|とみ}の{象徴|しょうちょう} (symbol of wealth)

RELATED WORDS:
- {富|と}む (to be rich, to abound — the verb form)
- {富裕|ふゆう} (wealthy, affluent — a formal compound)
- {豊|ゆた}か (abundant, rich — an adjective describing richness in a broader sense)
